On-Chain Operator. Lesson 14.2, Automation: keepers, bots and agents without handing over the keys. Navy and cyan. One idea at a time. You write it down. Education only.
You already have a playbook. Automation may watch it. Automation may not hold your keys.
Keeper / automation networks execute pre-defined actions when conditions are met (e.g.
repay when HF < 1.8, rebalance an LP range).
Smart-account permissions / session keys: grant a bot the right to do one thing (e.g.
repay debt on one protocol, up to $X per day), revocable at any time.
AI agents and bots: treat them like any other contract permission.
They get scoped rights, never your seed phrase or unlimited approvals.
Test on a testnet or with tiny amounts first; log every automated action.

Work the example on paper. Automated repay: a session key allowed only to call repay on your lending position, from your operating wallet, capped at $5,000/day, expiring in 30 days. Stamp it Example. It is not a level to copy onto a live position.

Check yourself. 1. What's a session key? The answer: A limited, revocable permission for a specific action.
Check yourself. 2. Should an AI agent ever get your seed phrase? The answer: No. Give it scoped, revocable permissions only.
Check yourself. 3. Worst case of a well-scoped repay bot? The answer: It repays debt within its cap. No funds leave your control.
